# FundAdmin AI

> Supervised-pilot release candidate: 60 fund administration skills plus the fund menu for Claude Code, Cowork and Codex. Review documents, prepare drafts and evidence-linked calculations for human review. Python 3.9+ is required for report helpers; external checks depend on authorised tools and evidence. Not certified for production operations or automated investment, admission, clearance, filing or payment decisions. Human review required; external operational qualification not tested. Host/model and optional connector data flows apply. Not financial, legal or tax advice.

Python 3.9+ is required for standard-library helpers; PDF dependencies are pinned in requirements-plugin.txt.
Primary runtime qualification: installed Claude Code 2.1.278, explicit model trace and all 18 saved cases for the candidate; consult the verification record. Codex and Cowork support the package format but their runtimes are experimental/unverified; Codex evidence is direct inline only, Cowork unverified.
The plugin marketplace is the supported installation route: Claude Code and Cowork install this published release, and in a Codex or ChatGPT workspace an administrator imports the same marketplace and pins the reviewed immutable release tag fundadmin--v1.3.2 for the pilot group, keeping access, data and connected-app permissions under administrator control.
Third-party skill installers such as npx skills copy selected raw skill files into an agent-specific skills directory. They do not install the plugin, its agents, its marketplace metadata or its release assets, and the skills then run without the packaged agents and report helper: developer compatibility only, not a route for supervised pilots.
Use one installation method per environment. Development branches and local checkouts are not user installation targets. Private host evidence belongs outside plugin build inputs.
Anthropic publishes a separate marketplace, anthropics/financial-services (https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services), with general finance-operations plugins: ledger reconciliation, break tracing, accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary, NAV tie-out, a KYC screener, financial models and market-data connectors. FundAdmin AI covers the private-fund documents those plugins do not: LPAs, side letters, PPMs, subscription documents, capital calls, distributions, capital accounts, K-1s, waterfalls, fees and MFN elections, with KYC routing built around fund investor types. The two install side by side and their skill names do not overlap. FundAdmin AI is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
Direct and routed skills use shared report contract v1 and reviews/<fund>/<date>/<run-id>/<subfolder>/<report-id>/<filename>; evidence sidecars retain source/output hashes.

- [Samples](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/samples/README.md): synthetic documents with planted issues

- [Pilot limits](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/docs/production/README.md): supervised-pilot release candidate, not certified production

- [Privacy](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills#privacy): host/model and connector data flows

## Skills

- [fund](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund/SKILL.md): Main menu and router for the 60 FundAdmin AI skills: fund document review, notice drafting, compliance, negotiation, tracking, analytics, intake and reporting. For bare `/fund` or `/fundadmin:fund` with no subcommand: you MUST ALWAYS invoke this skill via the Skill tool (input matching fund) BEFORE answering, then emit the full 60-command menu including review-lpa, review-capital-call, draft-capital-call, report-pdf. Answering that menu without a Skill tool call is incorrect — do not reconstruct it from memory or catalog alone. Also use when the user asks what the assistant can do, lists commands, or asks for a fund admin task without naming a skill. Route `/fund <cmd>` and `/fundadmin:fund <cmd>` (including wire-verify) to the matching fund-<cmd> skill via the Skill tool. Every output is a draft for qualified human review.
- [fund-review-lpa](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-lpa/SKILL.md): Runs the 5-agent LPA pipeline (terms, risks, compliance, obligations, recommendations) into methodology v2 heuristic document favourability, or an explicit unavailable result. Use when the user runs `/fund review-lpa`, asks to review fund terms, or shares an LPA. Writes `LPA-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-ppm](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-ppm/SKILL.md): Reviews a PPM or offering memorandum for risk factor completeness, fee disclosure clarity, stated regulatory status (Reg D, 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7), ERISA) and LPA consistency, as counts. Use when the user runs `/fund review-ppm`, asks to review offering documents, or shares a PPM. Writes `PPM-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-subscription](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-subscription/SKILL.md): Reviews a subscription agreement for identity, qualification, tax forms, AML and ERISA representations and signatures; a signed representation is not verification. Use when the user runs `/fund review-subscription` or shares subscription documents. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-REVIEW-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-side-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-side-letter/SKILL.md): Builds an obligation inventory from a side letter, categorizes every right, rates MFN cascade risk, and flags LPA and cross-side-letter conflicts. Use when the user runs `/fund review-side-letter`, asks about MFN exposure, or shares a side letter. Writes `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md` with an investor pseudonym.
- [fund-review-capital-call](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-capital-call/SKILL.md): Recomputes an incoming capital call notice: pro-rata math, fee line items, wire instructions, due dates, and LPA consistency, then scores it 1-10. Use when the user runs `/fund review-capital-call`, asks to verify a capital call, or shares a call notice. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-distribution-notice](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-distribution-notice/SKILL.md): Recomputes a distribution notice: private-fund types, unfunded impact and waterfall, or listed-trust imputation and withholding. Use when the user runs `/fund review-distribution-notice`, asks to check a distribution, or shares a distribution notice. Writes DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-capital-account](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-capital-account/SKILL.md): Recomputes a capital account statement to the currency unit: extracts every field, checks ending capital arithmetic, reconciles tranches. Use when the user runs `/fund review-capital-account`, asks to verify a statement, or shares a capital account statement. Writes CAPITAL-ACCOUNT-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-k1](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-k1/SKILL.md): Extracts a Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) by its actual labels and codes, reconciles Item L with the packaged helper, and flags UBTI, ECI, K-3 and Box 19 items for the preparer. Use when the user runs `/fund review-k1`, asks to check a K-1, or shares a K-1 tax package. Writes `K1-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-poa](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-poa/SKILL.md): Reviews a Power of Attorney used in fund work: classifies it as investor/LPA or transactional, extracts grantor, attorneys and authority, rates breadth of discretion, and lists cross-border questions for counsel. Use when the user runs `/fund review-poa` or shares a POA or mandate. Writes POA-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-gp-update](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-gp-update/SKILL.md): Analyzes a GP activity update: FPAUM bridge tie-out, deployment, realisations, fundraising, MOIC vs GP-stated targets and presentation checks, as a cited exception list. Use when the user runs `/fund review-gp-update`, asks how a GP is executing, or shares a GP activity update. Writes GP-UPDATE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-compare](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-compare/SKILL.md): Compares two fund documents and rates each difference material, significant, administrative, or cosmetic, flagging who it favors, GP or LPs. Use when the user runs `/fund compare`, asks what changed between versions, or shares two LPAs or side letters. Writes FUND-COMPARISON-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-extract-terms](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-extract-terms/SKILL.md): Extracts all defined terms, fee provisions, key dates, governance and reporting obligations from a fund document, with plain English summaries and section references. Use when the user runs `/fund extract-terms` or asks to extract a document's terms. Writes TERMS-EXTRACT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-capital-call](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-capital-call/SKILL.md): Drafts a structured capital call notice with purpose breakdown, per-LP pro-rata table, unfunded-commitment impact, default consequences, and masked wire instructions. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-capital-call` or asks to draft a capital call. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-distribution](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-distribution/SKILL.md): Drafts a distribution notice: helper-supported waterfall tiers (others UNCALCULATED), per-LP split, evidenced withholding only, unfunded-commitment impact and clawback notation. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-distribution` or asks to draft a distribution. Writes DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-investor-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-investor-letter/SKILL.md): Drafts LP communications with a separate review cover: quarterly update, annual meeting notice, onboarding welcome, closing, final close, extension, wind-down or ad hoc reply. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-investor-letter <type>` or asks to write to LPs. Writes `INVESTOR-LETTER-[fund]-[type]-[date].md`.
- [fund-draft-side-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-side-letter/SKILL.md): Drafts an LP side letter from requested provisions (fee discount, MFN, co-invest, reporting, ERISA), citing a supplied LPA or marking sections [VERIFY], with conflict checks. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-side-letter` or asks to draft a side letter for an LP. Writes `SIDE-LETTER-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-check-compliance](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-check-compliance/SKILL.md): Reviews a document for evidence gaps against FATCA, CRS, AML/KYC, ERISA, Form PF/D/ADV, AIFMD and SFDR requirements; document language is not operational compliance. Use when the user runs `/fund check-compliance`, asks for a compliance gap check, or shares an LPA or PPM. Writes COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-kyc-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-review/SKILL.md): Reviews one investor KYC/AML package: extracts a structured record, applies the firm's rules grid and routes it to request documents, escalate for EDD or hold, with collection completeness out of 100. Use when the user runs `/fund kyc-review` or shares a KYC package. Writes KYC-REVIEW-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-regulatory-filing](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-filing/SKILL.md): Prepares a filing draft for Form PF/D/ADV, 13F/13H, FATCA/CRS or FBAR: extracts required data points, scores completeness and flags gaps against the deadline; no submission or certification. Use when the user runs `/fund regulatory-filing` or asks to prepare a filing. Writes FILING-PREP-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-audit-support](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-audit-support/SKILL.md): Drafts an audit support pack: representation letter draft, confirmation population for the auditor, and helper-backed capital and fee schedules. Use when the user runs `/fund audit-support`, asks to prepare for the annual audit, or shares capital account data. Writes AUDIT-SUPPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-waterfall-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-waterfall-review/SKILL.md): Extracts waterfall tiers, preferred return, catch-up, carry, clawback and fee terms, checks consistency and records comparisons only against identified, dated sources. Use when the user runs `/fund waterfall-review`, asks about fund economics, or shares waterfall provisions. Writes `WATERFALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-report-pdf](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-report-pdf/SKILL.md): Renders fund review Markdown or structured JSON into a formatted PDF, preserving report content, score labels and scales, evidence and limitations. Use when the user runs `/fund report-pdf` or asks for a PDF of a review. Writes FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf.
- [fund-lpa-negotiate](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-lpa-negotiate/SKILL.md): Turns LP-unfavorable LPA provisions into counter-proposal language, ranked P0 to P4 with push/trade/accept stances, a four-round roadmap and concession matrix. Use when the user runs `/fund lpa-negotiate` or asks for LPA negotiation strategy. Writes NEGOTIATION-STRATEGY-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-benchmark](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-benchmark/SKILL.md): Lists departures from ILPA published positions as discussion points and shows the illustrative reference ranges in this skill, labelled not market data, with each term's effect. Use when the user runs `/fund benchmark`, asks how terms compare, or shares an LPA. Writes BENCHMARK-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-plain-english](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-plain-english/SKILL.md): Translates a fund document clause by clause into plain English: practical impact, risk flags, a defined-terms glossary, and worked waterfall and clawback examples. Use when the user runs `/fund plain-english`, asks what a clause means, or shares an LPA or PPM. Writes PLAIN-ENGLISH-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-playbook](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-playbook/SKILL.md): Tracks how a firm's LPA terms drift across fund vintages and builds a negotiation playbook of observed positions and asks. Use when the user runs `/fund playbook`, asks how terms changed between Fund II and Fund III, or shares LPAs from several vintages. Writes TERMS-PLAYBOOK-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-search-precedent](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-search-precedent/SKILL.md): Searches prior review outputs for provisions matching a query, ranks matches by fund, vintage and section, and compares corpus positions versus outliers. Use when the user runs `/fund search-precedent` or asks how a clause was handled on past funds. Writes PRECEDENT-SEARCH-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-counsel-handoff](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-counsel-handoff/SKILL.md): Packages an LPA, PPM or side letter review into a brief for external counsel: P0-P3 triage, redline requests and open questions with section citations. Use when the user runs `/fund counsel-handoff`, asks to brief outside counsel, or shares a review file. Writes COUNSEL-HANDOFF-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-mfn-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-mfn-tracker/SKILL.md): Tracks MFN provisions across a fund's executed side letters, builds an eligibility matrix per LP, flags cascade risk, and drafts election forms and a redacted disclosure schedule. Use when the user runs `/fund mfn-tracker` or shares several side letters. Writes MFN-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-obligation-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-obligation-tracker/SKILL.md): Inventories every side letter obligation by category, frequency and due date, records the evidence supplied for each and flags what is outstanding. Use when the user runs `/fund obligation-tracker`, asks which deadlines are outstanding, or shares side letters. Writes OBLIGATION-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-covenant-monitor](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-covenant-monitor/SKILL.md): Extracts financial, reporting and negative covenants from a credit facility and recomputes headroom from supplied data; no compliance verdict. Use when the user runs `/fund covenant-monitor`, asks about covenant breach risk, or shares a subscription line or loan agreement. Writes COVENANT-MONITOR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-regulatory-calendar](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-calendar/SKILL.md): Builds a 12-month filing calendar from fund type, registration and AUM, spanning Form ADV/PF/D, 13F/13H, FATCA/CRS, AIFMD and UK SDR, with an event queue, watch list and 90/60/30-day alerts. Use when the user runs `/fund regulatory-calendar` or asks what filings are due. Writes REGULATORY-CALENDAR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-performance-calc](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-performance-calc/SKILL.md): Computes IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, MOIC, and PME from cash flows or a capital account statement, with helper bisection workpapers and J-curve analysis. Use when the user runs `/fund performance-calc`, asks what a fund returned, or shares cash flow data. Writes PERFORMANCE-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-cashflow-forecast](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-cashflow-forecast/SKILL.md): Projects capital calls, distributions, and NAV from explicit dated assumptions using deterministic Decimal workpapers, with scenario comparisons. Use when the user runs `/fund cashflow-forecast` or asks to forecast calls or LP liquidity. Writes CASHFLOW-FORECAST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-scenario-model](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-scenario-model/SKILL.md): Runs user-specified named scenario schedules through deterministic workpapers: NAV, calls, distributions, TVPI/DPI, dated IRR and single-event waterfall tiers, with explicit sensitivity runs. Use when the user runs `/fund scenario-model` or asks to stress-test returns. Writes `SCENARIO-MODEL-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-fee-audit](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-fee-audit/SKILL.md): Recomputes management fees and offsets with the packaged helper, checks carry terms against the supplied LPA and lists exceptions; pref accrual and clawback use supplied workpapers only. Use when the user runs `/fund fee-audit`, asks if fees are correct, or shares fee workpapers. Writes FEE-AUDIT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-investor-onboard](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-onboard/SKILL.md): Prepares an onboarding checklist by investor type: documents to collect, the qualification, tax and screening reviews to run, owners and a timeline. Does not screen or admit. Use when the user runs `/fund investor-onboard` or describes an incoming investor. Writes ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-ddq-respond](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ddq-respond/SKILL.md): Drafts answers to an investor DDQ or RFP mapped to the 20 ILPA DDQ 2.0 topics, citing sources, grading answers A-F and flagging questions that need human input. Use when the user runs `/fund ddq-respond`, asks to answer a DDQ, or shares a due diligence questionnaire. Writes `DDQ-RESPONSE-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-entity-map](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-entity-map/SKILL.md): Maps a fund structure into a Mermaid diagram, entity registry, ownership chain and fee-flow tables, flagging blocker, feeder and ERISA plan-asset gaps. Use when the user runs `/fund entity-map`, asks to diagram a structure, or shares formation documents. Writes ENTITY-MAP-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-data-room](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-data-room/SKILL.md): Drafts a data room index across eight categories with Required/Recommended/Optional status, gaps from a supplied document list and NDA-gated access tiers, for human approval. Use when the user runs `/fund data-room <type>` or asks how to organize a fundraising data room. Writes `DATA-ROOM-[fund]-[type]-[date].md`.
- [fund-portfolio-dashboard](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-portfolio-dashboard/SKILL.md): Aggregates several funds' supplied statements into one LP view: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, strategy and GP mix, J-curve stage, and unfunded commitments. Use when the user runs `/fund portfolio-dashboard`, asks how the book is doing, or shares capital accounts across funds. Writes PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-reconcile](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-reconcile/SKILL.md): Matches two fund documents line by line (capital call vs capital account, distribution vs K-1, sequential statements, PCAPs vs financial statements) and lists every break with helper workpapers. Use when the user runs `/fund reconcile` or asks why balances do not tie. Writes RECONCILIATION-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-deed](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-deed/SKILL.md): Reviews a deed of adherence, equity wrapper, or management participation agreement: obligations assumed, vesting, good and bad leaver terms, and information access limits. Use when the user runs `/fund review-deed`, asks to check leaver terms, or shares a deed. Writes DEED-REVIEW-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-investor-classify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-classify/SKILL.md): Drafts a preliminary investor classification from supplied documents, with the document requirements checklist and the FATCA, CRS, ERISA, UBTI and ECI questions to resolve. Use when the user runs `/fund investor-classify` or asks to classify an investor. Writes INVESTOR-CLASSIFICATION-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-fatca-crs-classify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-fatca-crs-classify/SKILL.md): Reviews W-8, W-9 and CRS self-certifications into a preliminary FATCA Chapter 3/4 and CRS classification, marking unresolved facts and form gaps incomplete. Use when the user runs `/fund fatca-crs-classify` or shares a W-8 or CRS self-certification. Writes FATCA-CRS-CLASSIFICATION-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-suitability-check](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-suitability-check/SKILL.md): Reviews evidence for the accredited investor, qualified purchaser and qualified client tests, recording each as supported or incomplete; does not determine eligibility. Use when the user runs `/fund suitability-check` or asks whether an investor qualifies. Writes `SUITABILITY-CHECK-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-aml-screen](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-aml-screen/SKILL.md): Reviews supplied AML/CFT evidence: identity, ownership, PEP/sanctions records and funds/wealth; preserves missing checks and potential matches; no live screening. Use when the user runs `/fund aml-screen`, asks to screen an investor, or shares a KYC questionnaire. Writes AML-SCREENING-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-kyc-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-tracker/SKILL.md): Tracks KYC collection across every investor in a fund: per-investor completeness, outstanding document matrix, expiry alerts and refresh cycles by risk rating, with an Excel tracker. Use when the user runs `/fund kyc-tracker` or asks where fund-wide KYC stands. Writes KYC-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-subscription-process](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-subscription-process/SKILL.md): Coordinates the classification, documents, suitability, FATCA/CRS and screening reviews into one evidence and gap report; admission stays a separate human decision. Use when the user runs `/fund subscription-process` or asks what blocks an investor. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-PROCESS-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-ingest](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest/SKILL.md): Classifies a folder of mixed fund PDFs, routes each to its `/fund review-*` skill, runs reconciliation on matching pairs and the portfolio dashboard at 3+ funds. Use when the user runs `/fund ingest` or drops a folder of GP portal PDFs. Writes INGEST-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md and INGEST-MANIFEST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-ingest-email](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest-email/SKILL.md): Parses an email or .eml and its attachments, then cross-validates the amounts, deadlines and fund names it claims against the documents to flag mismatches and wire-change red flags. Use when the user runs `/fund ingest-email` or pastes a GP email with attachments. Writes EMAIL-INGEST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-monitor-email](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-monitor-email/SKILL.md): Reads an explicitly authorised Gmail scope for fund emails, stages PDF, XLSX and DOCX attachments in an isolated review run and logs provenance. No automatic processing. Use when the user runs `/fund monitor-email` or asks to check for new GP documents. Writes EMAIL-MONITOR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-multi-doc-analyze](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-multi-doc-analyze/SKILL.md): Cross-references 2+ related fund documents for provision conflicts, amendment lineage, and MFN cascades. Use when the user runs `/fund multi-doc-analyze`, asks how an LPA, side letters, and amendments interact, or shares several fund documents together. Writes MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-smart-contract-sim](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-smart-contract-sim/SKILL.md): Runs the packaged whole-fund waterfall helper on user-supplied scenarios: tier traces, edge cases and pseudocode; clawback and deal-by-deal stay UNCALCULATED. Use when the user runs `/fund smart-contract-sim`, asks how a waterfall would execute, or shares LPA waterfall terms. Writes `WATERFALL-SIM-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-chat](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-chat/SKILL.md): Conversational query interface over fund documents and prior `/fund` outputs, answering with document, section, and exact-quote citations and routing to the command that fills a data gap. Use when the user runs `/fund chat` or asks ad hoc questions about their fund documents. Answers inline.
- [fund-amendment-draft](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-amendment-draft/SKILL.md): Drafts a formatted LPA amendment with recitals, amendment clauses, ratification, signature blocks, and a redline of old versus new text. Use when the user runs `/fund amendment-draft`, asks to amend an LPA, or shares an LPA with the changes wanted. Writes AMENDMENT-DRAFT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-esg-report](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-esg-report/SKILL.md): Drafts a preliminary ESG report for applicable SFDR, climate, EDCI, PRI and Taxonomy frameworks from supplied data, with explicit gaps; does not certify SFDR compliance. Use when the user runs `/fund esg-report`, asks for an SFDR or PAI disclosure, or shares portfolio ESG data. Writes ESG-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-tax-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-tax-review/SKILL.md): Analyzes a K-1 or tax package for UBTI, ECI, Section 199A QBI, 163(j) limits, state filing questions, PFIC exposure and capital account reconciliation. Use when the user runs `/fund tax-review` or asks what a K-1 means for UBTI, ECI, withholding or state filing. Writes `TAX-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-board-memo](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-board-memo/SKILL.md): Drafts a board, LPAC, annual or special meeting memo: agenda, sourced performance, conflict disclosures, LPAC process checklist and GP-owned recommendation slots. Use when the user runs `/fund board-memo <type>` or asks to prepare LPAC or annual meeting materials. Writes `BOARD-MEMO-[fund]-[type]-[date].md`.
- [fund-wire-verify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-wire-verify/SKILL.md): Flags bank/beneficiary changes and missing callback evidence for wire instructions; prepares a masked checklist; no payment approval. Use for `/fund wire-verify`, `/fundadmin:fund wire-verify`, new bank details, payment-instruction checks, or a shareable wire report that must mask account/tax/passport IDs.

## Agents

- [fund-terms](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-terms.md): Terms & Provisions, 25% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-risks](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-risks.md): Risk Assessment, 31.25% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-compliance](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-compliance.md): Regulatory Compliance, 25% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-obligations](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-obligations.md): Obligations & Timeline, 18.75% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-recommendations](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-recommendations.md): Recommendations (excluded), 0% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)

Terms runs first; risk/compliance/obligations depend on terms and may run in parallel; recommendations run last and are excluded. Unknown dimensions make the aggregate unavailable. Coverage confidence is separate.
